name: Simply Enchantments
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Hyperlinkhyper
description: This mod adds allot of new and exciting enchantments in the game!

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: The Simply Cozy enchantment library's server command /simplycozy enchantmenteffect <true|false> turns the Simply Cozy enchantment effects on or off, saves it, and says "Simply Cozy enchantment effects are now enabled|disabled".
note: Not yet: the enchantments and their effects belong to Simply Cozy (simplycozymod), which reads the switch through the system property simplycozy.enchantment_effects_enabled; this library's mixin into MinecraftServer is an empty example.
